WITH per_type AS (
    SELECT
        e.type,
        AVG(1.0 * b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_spent_ratio
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e
        ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE b.spent <> 0
      AND b.spent IS NOT NULL
      AND b.amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT
    type,
    avg_spent_ratio,
    avg_spent_ratio - AVG(avg_spent_ratio) OVER () AS distance_from_mean
FROM per_type;
